name: career-alpha
description: AI-native career operating system for trend discovery, asymmetric opportunity finding, proof-of-work building, evidence-first positioning, interview defense, and job pipeline management.

interface.shortDescription: Find asymmetric career opportunities and turn them into verifiable proof.
interface.longDescription: Career Alpha helps users discover emerging career trends, identify supply-demand wedges, build proof of work, create evidence-backed positioning, defend claims in interviews, and manage job-search pipelines.
defaultPrompt: Use /radar to scan emerging career opportunities.
Use /wedge to find an asymmetric entry point.
Use /contributor to build verified open-source evidence.
Use /build to design a 2–7 day proof-of-work project.
Use /proof to turn work into an evidence ledger.
Use /position to translate evidence into job-market language.
Use /offer to manage the job-search pipeline.
